podcast.title: Founded by Ian MacKaye and DIY Ethic
podcast.body: Dischord Records was founded by Ian MacKaye and Minor Threat as part of their serious do-it-yourself (DIY) ethic. The label became a platform for Minor Threat's own material and eventually for other hardcore bands. "They had a serious do-it-yourself ethic, founding a record label called Discord that would eventually release material by other hardcore bands."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Founding by Minor Threat
podcast.body: Dischord was a record label founded by Ian MacKaye and other members of Minor Threat as part of their do-it-yourself (DIY) ethic. "founding a record label called Discord that would eventually release material by other hardcore bands."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Policy of Low Record Prices
podcast.body: A key principle of Dischord Records was a strict policy of keeping record prices low and affordable, making music accessible to their fanbase. "Second, they had a strict policy of keeping record prices low and affordable."
